manual.title: Clearlight sauna
manual.description: Enter the sauna's IP address. Give it a DHCP reservation on your router so it doesn't move.

upgrade_heater.title: Upgrade heater
upgrade_heater.description:
Has Clearlight's **Full Spectrum Upgrade Heater** been activated on this sauna? It plugs into the IEC receptacle by the door. Activation is a one-time keypad sequence: turn the sauna on, switch to °C, set 60 °C, then hold AUX for 5 seconds until it beeps.

Once activated, the AUX output runs the upgrade heater together with the sauna's own heaters. Toggling AUX over the network, from Home Assistant or the Clearlight app, silently takes the sauna out of heater mode and turns AUX back into a manual outlet with no timer.

- **Upgrade heater activated:** Home Assistant never changes AUX. You get a read-only heater relay sensor, and a Repairs warning if heater mode is lost.
- **No upgrade heater:** you get an AUX outlet switch.

If the heater is installed but not activated yet, choose **Upgrade heater activated** anyway so Home Assistant leaves AUX alone, and run the keypad sequence when you can. You can change this later under **Configure**.

data_description.upgrade_heater: Turn on if you've run the keypad sequence for Clearlight's Full Spectrum Upgrade Heater, or if the heater is installed but not activated yet. The AUX switch is replaced by a read-only heater relay sensor, because toggling AUX over the network takes the sauna out of heater mode.

heater_mode_lost.title: {name}: upgrade heater mode is off
heater_mode_lost.description:
The sauna's AUX output is on while the sauna isn't heating. That means the controller has left upgrade-heater mode, usually because AUX was toggled in the Clearlight app. The heater receptacle is no longer tied to the session timer or thermostat.

To fix it, at the keypad: turn the sauna on, switch the display to °C, set 60 °C, then hold AUX for 5 seconds until it beeps. Then turn the sauna off. This warning clears when the AUX output turns off together with the sauna.

schedule_ready.name: Schedule ready by
schedule_ready.description: Have the sauna at a temperature by a time of day. The integration starts it early enough, from its heat-up estimate, and sets the session to the heat-up time plus the time at temperature.

ready_by.name: Ready by
ready_by.description: Time of day the sauna should be at temperature: the next time this clock time comes round.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Target temperature, in your Home Assistant temperature unit.

minutes_at_temperature.name: Minutes at temperature
minutes_at_temperature.description: How long the session runs once the target is expected to be reached.

cancel_ready.name: Cancel ready by
cancel_ready.description: Drop a pending ready-by plan. A session already running isn't stopped.

set_heatup_calibration.name: Set heat-up calibration
set_heatup_calibration.description: Replace what the heat-up estimate has learned about this sauna, for example to correct a session that calibrated from bad data. Leave a field out to keep its current value. Later cold starts keep adjusting it.

rise.name: Rise
rise.description: How far above room temperature the cabin would level off with the heaters on, as a temperature difference in your Home Assistant unit (the Time to target sensor's delta_t_f attribute, in °F).

time_constant.name: Time constant
time_constant.description: How quickly the cabin approaches that level, in minutes (the time_constant_min attribute).

target_out_of_reach.message: {target} °F can't be reached within {minutes} minutes from room temperature, by this sauna's heat-up estimate.

temperature_out_of_range.message: The temperature must be between {min} and {max}.

calibration_nothing_to_set.message: Give a rise, a time constant, or both.

rise_out_of_range.message: The rise must be between {min} and {max}.
